items.text: Isaiah Likely love: 4th in TE FPTS/target last 3 yrs; 8/9 games w/ 6+ tgts hit 12.5+ PPR. Nabers not 100%; WR2 Fields/Mooney.
Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. unlikely to play vs Falcons (back) amid contract/trade murk.
Maxx Crosby will play for Raiders after nixed trades; told teams including Rams he did not want trade.
Chuba Hubbard viable flex this week; keeping it open.
Saquon Barkley vs WAS: 136.5 rush yds/6.0 YPC and 21+ PPR in 4 games since joining PHI (incl playoffs). WAS front below avg.
Chris Olave w/ Tyler Shough: 29% target share, 14.7+ PPR in 75% games. Lions safeties on IR; high O/U. Shough waiver available many leagues.
items.implication: Strong WR2/3 start; Shough streaming QB
items.opportunity: High target share in up-tempo game

items.text: Justin Herbert FPPAs 52% higher w/ Joe Alt on field last year. Alt healthy. Cards DL 31st/pressure 27th, secondary 26th PFF.
items.why: OT health + weak pass rush matchup

items.text: When MHJ 50%+ snaps, Michael Wilson 5.5 PPG/13% share; off field 28%. MHJ expected to play.
items.implication: Fade Wilson if MHJ full; MHJ start
items.opportunity: MHJ primary; Wilson flex only if limited

items.text: Parker Washington 24% target share when 70%+ routes; 16.4 PPG at 15%+ share career. Ward on BTJ; Jags-Browns.
